summary: Tap, long press, pan, pinch, rotation and swipe recognizers exist as pure state machines, with a shared arbiter and a screen-edge pan for the shell; the responder chain is shared. Apps receive touches with an id on the wire, but the retained view layer drops the id, so view-level multi-touch gestures, hover recognizers and the touch-to-view arbitration are still missing. The tablet path (wl_touch to recognizers) is not yet verified on the tablet.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.apple: UIResponder, Using responders and the responder chain to handle events
features.note: actions go to the first responder and outwards; menu items and toolbar buttons are enabled by the same walk. No touchesBegan family: views get Pointer(Down, Move, Up) and Cancel

features.apple: UIEvent, UITouch (location, phase, tapCount, majorRadius, timestamp, type)
features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/lib.rs, springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, springboard/src/bare/wl_touch.rs, springboard/wm/src/touch.rs, springboard/ui/src/touch.rs, springboard/proto/src/touch.rs
features.note: Touch frames reach apps as ToApp::Touches (sdk/src/touch_events.rs); the shell's wl_touch path turns each finger into a contact and the compositor delivers them with the output transform. Host tests only; not yet verified on the tablet.
Tap handles single and multiple taps with slop and interval limits; single-finger only
LongPress with minimum duration and allowable movement; one finger
Pan gives translation and velocity for one finger; no multi-touch pan
Magnify (two-finger spacing ratio) and Rotate (unwrapped angle) as pure models; nothing delivers two contacts to a view yet
Pure Swipe recognizer (direction mask, touch count, distance, speed, off-axis ratio) in the shared recognizer set; no view-level UISwipeGestureRecognizer yet. Not yet verified on the tablet.
the shell recognizes edge drags (Control Center, home indicator swipe) for itself; apps cannot request an edge pan
tracking areas report pointer enter, exit and move as a model; the app protocol has no hover event
Recognizers track several fingers by id; GestureArbiter gives require-failure and simultaneous rules, and the shell's system gestures run on it. Not yet verified on the tablet.
each recognizer is a plain struct fed events by the caller; apps can write more, but there is no shared protocol to attach them to a view
Input::Key delivers key events; remote and game controller presses are separate (springboard/sdk/src/gamepad_service.rs)

features.apple: Handling input from Apple Pencil, force, altitude, azimuth
features.note: stylus samples map to stroke points with force, altitude and azimuth; the app protocol touch has no pressure or tilt fields yet
pressure-sensitive hardware is no longer shipped; context menus cover the use

gaps: Pass touch id and time into ViewEvent so views can see several fingers
Recognizer base trait with failure requirements and simultaneous recognition, attached to views
Swipe and screen-edge-pan recognizers for apps
Hover events from the pointer to apps
Pressure, tilt and touch type on the touch wire
